title: Ultra-precision CNC turning/milling (micron tolerance)
description: Ultra-precision CNC turning/milling (micron tolerance) capability for titanium components
thicknessRange: Up to 400 mm diameter x 1000 mm length
processDescription: CNC turning of titanium on multi-axis lathes produces cylindrical components with precision diameters and surface finishes. Live tooling enables milling and drilling in the same setup, specifically for micro features. Micro features for medical and watchmaking applications present unique challenges: feature sizes < 0.2 mm require micro-tools (Ø0.1–0.5 mm) operating at 40,000+ RPM. Tool breakage detection via spindle load monitoring is essential.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-tool for chip breaking and heat evacuation.
flatnessControl: Steady rests for long, slender parts. Stress-relieved stock is recommended.
